Unused standard products can be returned within 30 days. A receipt is required. Shipping fees are not refundable. Damaged products are replaced free of charge.

# Beacon API operations

## Health
GET /health returns HTTP 200 when ready.

## Retry settings
| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| timeout_seconds | 12 |
| max_retries | 3 |

## Restart procedure
1. Stop new requests.
2. Drain active requests.
3. Restart the Beacon process.
4. Check GET /health before resuming traffic.

## Troubleshooting
HTTP 503 means the service is temporarily unavailable. Wait and retry with backoff.
